mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases discount rates and compresses equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, the market anticipates Fed rate cuts to stimulate the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and inflation is accelerating (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%), the market fears stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined as FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate a strong economy and increased consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250.0, the market anticipates Fed rate hikes to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) are both above their 1-year moving averages, the economy is in a strong housing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Lower industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening economy and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
